plan_name: Commercial Comprehensive Health Plan - Specialty Cardiac Diagnostic Guidelines
covered_indications: New-onset or progressive dyspnea of suspected cardiac etiology
Evaluation of suspected cardiomegaly, pulmonary edema, or pleural effusion

clinical_criteria.description: Documented physical examination noting dyspnea, edema, or rales
Initial frontline plain radiography indicated prior to advanced cross-sectional imaging
No duplicate chest radiograph performed within preceding 7 days without acute clinical change

exclusions: Routine screening in asymptomatic non-surgical patients
Standalone experimental or investigational unvalidated automated diagnostic software
statutory_notice: ANVESH evidence outputs are assistive decision-support tools. Final authorization requires explicit licensed human review.
